nodes.description: TellorStorage.TellorStorageStruct `tellor` — packed storage struct holding uintVars, addressVars, balances, disputes and request details for the Tellor oracle proxy.
address public constant newTellor = 0x8B4F4d5F6DDCB459e405b83F2fCa22a139f924A5 — the upgraded Tellor implementation address used after the transition.
address public constant currentTellor = 0xC5721b1b753B0E2129F88694762C718c36442e7c — the legacy Tellor implementation address used as the default delegatecall target.
internal _transition() — overwrites tellor.uintVars (timeTarget, difficulty, version) and sets tellor.addressVars[keccak256("tellorContract")] to newTellor; it has no access-control guard of its own.
internal view _isReady() — returns true when tellor.uintVars[keccak256("slotProgress")] == 0, i.e. no mining round is currently in progress.
external payable fallback — conditionally runs the transition, then delegatecalls the full msg.data to currentTellor or newTellor and bubbles up returned or reverted data.
msg.sender — arbitrary external caller of the payable fallback; an unauthenticated trigger for the one-time transition.
delegatecall executed inside inline assembly with the complete msg.data to addr (currentTellor/newTellor), running foreign code in TellorTransition's own storage context.
Unprotected write of tellor.addressVars[keccak256("tellorContract")] to newTellor, permanently redirecting the proxy without any owner/onlyOwner guard.
address addr — the delegatecall target local, initialised to currentTellor and switched to newTellor after a successful transition.
bytes _calldata = msg.data — local buffer holding the raw calldata forwarded into the assembly delegatecall.

edges.reason: Any external account (msg.sender) can invoke the payable fallback; there is no authentication on the entry point.
The fallback calls _isReady() to decide whether the transition may be executed.
The fallback calls _transition() for the first qualified caller, letting anyone mutate the system configuration and the active implementation address.
_isReady reads tellor.uintVars[keccak256("slotProgress")] from the packed storage struct.
_transition writes tellor.uintVars (timeTarget, difficulty, version) and tellor.addressVars (tellorContract) into storage.
_transition reads the constant newTellor and stores it as the new tellorContract address.
The fallback reads the constant currentTellor as the default delegatecall target.
The fallback enters the inline assembly block and executes the delegatecall.
delegatecall executes foreign code in TellorTransition's storage context, so the callee can re-enter and mutate tellor state while the proxy logic is running.
Caller-supplied msg.data is forwarded verbatim into the delegatecall, so msg.sender fully controls the selector and arguments executed.
Local addr is initialised from currentTellor and conditionally reassigned to newTellor.
addr is the delegatecall target address (currentTellor or newTellor).
The _calldata local is loaded with msg.data before the assembly block runs.
The _calldata pointer and length are passed to delegatecall as the calldata region.
_transition performs the unprotected tellorContract overwrite with no owner check.
The overwrite mutates tellor.addressVars[keccak256("tellorContract")] in storage, permanently changing the proxy's delegatecall target.

normalization_plan.reason: addr is only a temporary local holding the delegatecall target address (currentTellor/newTellor); it should be folded into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_calldata is only a local copy of msg.data used as the delegatecall input buffer; it should be folded into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
